deadline_pattern: upcoming requirements|minimum (?:sdk|xcode)|target api level|api level requirement|must be built with

actions.dev_preview: Awareness: read the behavior-change docs and triage risks. Give your partner a heads-up.
actions.beta: Awareness: skim release notes for behavior changes. Confirm the partner is tracking it.
actions.public_beta: Start regression testing on test devices. Engage the partner developer.
actions.platform_stability: Key milestone: APIs are frozen. Begin full regression testing now (or confirm the partner has).
actions.rc: Final sign-off pass on release-candidate builds.
actions.ga: Monitor crash and analytics data by OS version for about a week. Confirm partner compatibility status.
actions.deadline: Requirement or deadline announcement: read it, then add the actual date to manual_events in config.json.
actions.manual: Hard date: confirm build and release work is scheduled.
